tools.name: inbox_reply
tools.description: Answer the agent event just announced. kind `ack` means the user will handle it themselves; `instruct` sends text for the agent to act on. An instruct is held by the system: it reads your exact text back to the user and sends it only if the user says yes in their next turn.
